filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the same temple, by the same chief.

cells.place: No
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Putiūr (alias) Mal-Gangapadi-nāḍu. Attested by Tayilanallī-Perumāḷ and Vijāpadarāyan and communicated to Vilāḍarāyar and the accountants of the temple.

cells.place: On the stone trough for the sacred tirtha, in the same temple ..
cells.remarks: Registers that this nirmāliya-trough was the gift of a certain Vaniyaṇ Kavaṇ Kattandaṇ.

cells.place: On the south wall of the Brahmēśvara temple at Kokkarāyanpeṭ (Tirichengode taluk, Salem district).
cells.date:
Śaku 1453, Vikriti, Arpasi,
26th day, sn. dī.
12, Punuryasu, Monday.
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Tagađappadipalaiyam alias Vadivudaiyamaṅguipuram to the temple of Brahmīsvaram-udaiya-Tambirāṇar, by a certain Sama-Nuyiṇar, agent of Krishnaraya-Nayaka.

cells.location: Ipūru, Vinukonda taluk, Guntur district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north wall of the same temple; left of entrance.
cells.date: Śaku 1438, lévara (wrong), Tai, 2[9](th day, Parva-Phal-gunt, 14, Ayushya-yōga, Monday.)
cells.remarks: The king receives, among others, the title Rajakkāl-tambirān. Heggādaru the gift of the village Samā-gumāpura, to the same temple.

cells.place: On the same wall ..
cells.remarks: Unfinished and damaged. Seems to record a gift of two villages (?) for the enjoyment and repairs of the temple of Brahmēśvara and for the maintenance of a dancing-master, etc., in the temple.

cells.place: On four slabs built into the floor of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Registers the detailed provisions made for offerings at the temple of Kōvīśvara-Muḍaiyār at Kūvarai in Naḍalv-nāḍu a district of Koṅgu alias Vīra-Chōḷa-maṇḍalam by Gaṅgaikoṇḍa Ammaiappan alias Adhirājarāja, for the health of the emperor (chakravartin).

cells.place: On the north and east walls of the Madhyapārīśvara temple at Kūgalūr (Gōpicheṭṭipāḷayam taluk, Coimbatore district).
cells.remarks: Mutilated and stones out of order. An imperfect copy of No. 165 of 1910. Seems to record a gift of land for a lamp by Nāṭṭu-Aṇḍān and other inhabitants of Kūvarai in Kaṇḍalūr-nāḍu. (Annual Report for 1911, page 77, paragraph 37).

cells.place: On the east wall of the same temple
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Seems to record a gift of land for a lamp by a certain Śōkkan Nāṭṭuppan of Kavalūr in Kaṇḍalūr-nāḍu to the temple of Naṭṭar-Aṇḍār of that place.

cells.place: Above the entrance into the same temple
cells.remarks: Built in at the right end.

cells.place: On inscribed slabs from Amarāvati preserved in the underground room of the Central Museum, Madras.
cells.remarks: Will be sent to Dr. Lüders for publication in the Epigraphia Indica. One of these mentions the gift of a king Gōṭampata Arska Siri-yaṭin-Salakani and another, the Upasaka Utara.

cells.place: On another slab in the same room
cells.remarks: Was evidently a grandson of him whose inscription is published on p. 146 ff. of Epigraphia Indica, Vol. VI.

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another slab in the same room
cells.remarks: These (tab) of Chochi-seṭṭi son of Honni-seṭṭi, a merchant of Peṇugonda. Will be sent to Dr. Lüders for publication in the Epigraphia Indica. One of the slabs mentions a Vākāṭaka gaḥapati and another a certain Mahā-Chēḍamukha. A third registers the gift of a rail bar (sūchi) by 'Tukara'.

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another slab in the same room
cells.remarks: The temple [of] Kirtinārāyaṇa was made for the [image] of Kirtinārāyaṇa was built for a certain Nandapatra native of Borāpura, by the learned artisan Jayakīrti, son of Ādharacharya.

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another slab in the same room
cells.remarks: The [image] of Kirtinārāyaṇa was made for the same person, perhaps also the same artisan here mentioned to be a brother-in-law (śyāla) of the king.

cells.place: On a slab in the grounds outside the Museum building.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record grant of lands on this occasion to the temple of Copíśvara with the consent of the gauḍas of the village. One of them, which was an earlier agrahāra of the time of Cālukya Vikrama, is stated to have been founded by the Ekādaśi-vrati Gopālayasvāmī. Before at the beginning of Viaya-l'audayadeva who was ruling the [No.]paṁbravādi 32,000 country.

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab in the grounds outside the Museum building.
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama year 18, Śrīmukha, Āshādha, Amāvāsyā, Wednesday, Jākshāpinayana-Saṁkrānti.
cells.remarks: The 1,000 great men of Kubkāṇūr met together to make a grant of land to Vāsudeva-Ghātana.

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab in the grounds outside the Museum building.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Mentions Kövür in Mahgađu-nađa and seems to record gift of a lamp.

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab in the grounds outside the Museum building.
cells.date: [Kali 447[2], Śaka 1293, Virodhikrit, Mithuna, ba. di. 5, Wednesday, Dhanishṭhā.]
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Sworn to register the gift of the village 'Ilaiśkāraṇi to Brāhmaṇas, by a certain 'lām-maīya-Nāyaka.

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab in the grounds outside the Museum building.
cells.remarks: Gift of 90 sheep for the lamp to the temple of ... .Tanıyalantar in Suyutur-nādu, a sub-division of Puliyūr-kōttam, by a member of the gaṇattar who were administering that village. Another record on the other face of the same stone and of the same date, provides also for a lamp, and a garden.

cells.place: On a stone set up at the entrance into the Museum.
cells.date: 6th year, Rishabba, fu. di. 3, Sunday, Puuarvasu.
cells.remarks: Gift of the village of Tanpiyalattur in Suğattūr-nađa, a district of Puliyür-köttəm alias Kulottunga-doļa-valanađu in Juyangondašoļa-mazđulam, to the Aļiydviratam-kopđan-matđa of Tiruvappamalai. The order was issued by Pašohanadivanag Nilagangaraiyap.

cells.place: On another stone in the same place
cells.date: Şaka 1452, Virodhin, [Vpišchi]ka, fu. di. 13, Monday, Pushya. 2nd year, Mārgaļi.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Refers to the village Polubohalur [in] Tappilvattar-sima, in Jayankondaśōla-kōttam, a district of Puliyür in Jayankondasola-valanadu.

cells.place: On a third stone in the same place
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions the temple of Nirvanga-Perumāl at Tirumalmalai.

cells.place: On a fourth stone in the same place
cells.remarks: Registers that a certain Kaḷa-Vaiyyappar having built a temple for Āgarēśvara-Uḍaiyār at Polichchalūr in Śurattūr-nāḍu, a sub-division of Puliyūr-kōṭṭam in Jayaṅgoṇḍa-Toṇḍamaṇḍalam, Katti Yellappa-Nāyaka made a grant of land (?) to the temple for the merit of king Veṅkaṭapatirāya.

cells.place: On slabs in the Archaeological show room of the Madras Museum.
cells.remarks: Will be forwarded to Dr. Lüders for publication in the Epigraphia Indica. One of these mentions the thēra Mahādhammakathaka.

cells.place: On the base of a Jaina image in the same place.
cells.remarks: This is the image of Śāntināthadēva of the temple Yeraga Jinālaya founded by the Mahāpradhāna [Bra]hadēvaṇa, a lay disciple of Sakalabhadra-Bhaṭṭāraka entitled Mahāmaṇḍalāchārya and belonging to Mūlasaṅgha, Kuṇḍakundānvaya, Kāṇūr[gaṇa] and [Tin]triṇi-gachchha.

cells.place: On the base of another Jaina image in the same place.
cells.remarks: Records that king Sāḷvadēva, a great lover of Sāhitya, got an image of Śānti-Jina made according to rule and set it up.

cells.place: In the ruined temple of Narasiṁhasvāmin at the foot of the hill at Vinukoṇḍa (Vinukoṇḍa taluk, Guṇṭūr district); right of entrance.
cells.date: Śaka 1399, Hēmalambi, Kārtika, śu. di. 10, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Registers that the Sāgi chief Ganna or Gannama-Nāyaka, son of Gaḍa, grandson of Peda-Ganna and great grandson of Annama-Nāyaka of the fourth (i.e. Śūdra) caste founded the temple of Narasiṁha or Lakshmī-Nṛisiṁha at Vinikoṇḍa.

cells.place: In the same place, left of entrance
cells.date: Śaka 1399, Hēmalambi, Kārtika, śu. di. 10, Thursday.
cells.remarks: A translation of No. 527. The chief Gannama-Nāyaka receives the titles Karavāla-Bhairava, Puliyamārkolugaṇḍa and Gaṇḍabhēruṇḍa. Below the inscription is a fine figure of the fabulous man-bird Gaṇḍabhēruṇḍa lifting up two elephants with his two hands.

cells.place: On a stone placed in the verandah of the Sub-Registrar's office in the same village.
cells.remarks: This (stone) was set up by Padavalu Kaṭṭirāju entitled Immaḍigaṇḍa, Birudaṅga-Rudra, Kalliga-Nārāyaṇa and Ghaṇḍaśārdūla.

cells.place: In the same place
cells.date: Śaka 14[84], Dundubhi, Āshāḍha, śu. di. 11, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land for maintaining a flower-garden of the temple of Raghunāyaka at Vinukoṇḍa in Vinukoṇḍa-sīma which was the fief given to Koṇḍrājayyadēva Mahārāja by the Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja-Tirumalarājayyadēva-Mahārāja.

cells.place: On a slab built into the wall of the big Mosque in the same village.
cells.remarks: Records the erection of the mosque by 'Ali Riza Khan. Begins with quotations from the Qurān as well as praises of the Prophet and the twelve Imāms of the Shīa (Dr. Horovitz).

cells.place: On a pillar lying in front of the Gōpālasvāmin temple at Ipuru (same taluk, same district).
cells.date: Śaka 1200, Bahudhānya, Āshāḍha, śu. di. 11, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Gift of land by the sons of Bōlnāyuḍu, a body-guard (aṅga-raksha) of the king.

cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.date:
Śaka 1200, Babudhānya,
Āshādha, śu. dī.
11, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Gift of money by a merchant for offerings to the temple of Ālaḍanātha at Ipuru.

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the same temple by Channappa, son of Kāvūri Timmā-Nāyadu, for conducting special worship on the 10th tithi (daśami) [of each fortnight].

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Registers the foundation of the temple of Āllaḍa-nātha at [Ipu]ru and a gift of land to it for the merit of the Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Kōṭa Gaṇapamadēvammaṅgāru.

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the dancing girls of the same temple, for the merit of Bōḷnāyadu.

cells.location: Lālāpettai, Chidambaram taluk, South Arcot district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.date: Śaka 1185, Raktakshi, Chai[tra], śu. dī. 18, Wednesday.
cells.remarks: Gift of 55 goats for a lamp to the same temple by Goṅkaya, son of Śarāpasagaḍa.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the Virabhadrasvāmin temple, in the same village.
cells.date:
Śaka 1574, Khura, Vai-śakha, śu. dī.
Tvē:dyugādi-Akshatritiya, Saturday, Karkaṭaka-lagna which happened at 1½ ghafikas after sunrise.
cells.remarks: Registers that on this date Nandikēśvara (the sacred bull) in the temple of Vīrēśvara at Yipuru was re-wed by Śarāyāni Timmajāpantulu, t[h]e old one having become mutilated. A gift of land was also made for offerings.

cells.place: On a slab set up outside the prākāra of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Gift of money by the merchant Barchohu Narupa-seṭṭi for offerings to the temple of Kaḷadēvaru-Mahādēva, for the merit of the king.
